Fact.Name: Maximum Medicare Wages for an MFS Filer
Fact.Description: The maximum medicare wages (W-2 Box 5) a MFS filer might have without possibly needing to pay Additional Medicare Tax Defined in 26 CFR § 31.3101-2

Fact.Name: Maximum Medicare Wages for an MRJ Filer
Fact.Description: The maximum medicare wages (W-2 Box 5) a MFS filer might have without possibly needing to pay Additional Medicare Tax Defined in 26 CFR § 31.3101-2

Fact.Name: Maximum Medicare Wages for non-MFS Filer
Fact.Description: The maximum medicare wages (W-2 Box 5) filers with a status other than MFS might have without possibly needing to pay Additional Medicare Tax. Defined in 26 CFR § 31.3101-2

Fact.Name: Maximum Medicare Wages on a W-2 for Additional Medicare Tax

The filer has at least one W-2 that triggers filing form 8959.

Fact.Name: Medicare Wages Additonal Tax Threshhold
Fact.Description: The filing-status based threshold at which a filer might need to pay aditional medicare taxes and thereby requires Form 8959. Reported on Form 8959 line 5 when required.
